app.name: Buzz
app.description: Team chat on a self-hosted Buzz (Nostr) relay — humans and agents as signed members. Option B pilot: native PureDesktop surface, Block's relay underneath.

tools.name: fn_catchUpBriefing
tools.description: Compile a complete Buzz catch-up briefing in one call: relay connection status, user identity, full channel and DM inventory with unread and muted counts, and recent messages across unread channels (or specified channels) with mentions, authors, and activity summaries. Prefer this over chaining getBuzzContext, listChannels, and repeated readMessages calls.

channelIds.description: Optional list of specific channel ids, channel names, or DM names to include. Omit to automatically catch up on all unread channels (falling back to the active channel if nothing is unread).

messagesPerChannel.description: Maximum recent messages to fetch per channel (default 20, max 100).

maxChannels.description: Maximum channels to fetch message histories for in one call (default 8, max 20).

includeMuted.description: Include muted channels during automatic unread catch-up (default false).

includeQuietChannels.description: When fewer than maxChannels are unread, also fetch recent messages from quiet non-muted channels (default false).

tools.name: fn_channelSnapshot
tools.description: Inspect a Buzz channel or direct-message conversation in one call (resolved by channel id, channel name, or DM participant name): channel metadata, member roster with live online presence, recent messages with active edit/delete overlays and reactions, and shared media attachments.

channel.description: Channel id, channel name (with or without leading "#"), or DM participant display name. Defaults to the active channel.

messageLimit.description: Maximum recent messages to return, oldest first (default 40, max 200).

mediaLimit.description: Maximum recent media attachments to return (default 15, max 50; set 0 to omit media).

includeOfflineMembers.description: Include offline members in the roster listing (default true; false returns online members only).

tools.name: fn_personActivityDossier
tools.description: Build a complete Buzz activity dossier for one person (resolved by display name, npub, or hex key): profile identity, live online presence, shared channels and roles, existing DM status and recent DM messages, cross-channel recent messages, and shared media attachments.

person.description: Person to inspect: display name (case-insensitive), npub, or 64-char hex pubkey.

messageLimit.description: Maximum cross-channel recent messages by this person (default 15, max 50).

includeDmContext.description: Include recent messages from the existing 1:1 DM with this person if one exists (default true).

dmMessageLimit.description: Maximum recent messages to include from the 1:1 DM (default 15, max 50).

includeMedia.description: Include media attachments shared by this person across returned messages (default true).

tools.name: fn_searchBuzzTopics
tools.description: Search across every Buzz channel and DM (or a named subset of channels) in one call, optionally filtered to one author, returning matching messages grouped by channel with channel display names, match counts, timestamps, and author summaries.

query.description: Full-text search terms to look up across the relay.

channels.description: Optional subset of channel ids, channel names, or DM names to search. Omit to search every channel the user can read.

from.description: Optional author filter: display name, npub, or hex pubkey.

limit.description: Maximum total matching messages returned, newest first (default 30, max 100).

tools.name: getBuzzContext
tools.description: Current Buzz state: connection status, relay, own identity (npub and display name), the active channel, and which channels have unread messages.

tools.name: readMessages
tools.description: Read recent messages from a channel or DM, oldest first: author display name, text, ISO timestamp, attachments by name, and reply references. Edits and deletions are applied for the channel currently open in the app; other channels return the raw history.

channelId.description: Channel id from listChannels. Defaults to the active channel.

tools.name: sendMessage
tools.description: Post a message to a channel or DM as the user. The message is signed with their identity and visible to every member — use exactly the text the user approved. A release action: only a person can post, by pressing Send in Buzz, or by approving it as CEO in the Executive team. An agent cannot call this at any trust level; write the text in the conversation for the person to send.

channelId.description: Channel id from listChannels. Defaults to the active channel.

text.description: Message text (markdown subset: links, bold, italic, code).

tools.name: sendDirectMessage
tools.description: Send a direct message to one person as the user, opening the DM channel first if it does not exist. The message is signed with the user's identity — use exactly the text the user approved. A release action: only a person can post, by pressing Send in Buzz, or by approving it as CEO in the Executive team. An agent cannot call this at any trust level; write the text in the conversation for the person to send.

to.description: Who to message: a display name (see listMembers), an npub, or a hex key.

text.description: Message text (markdown subset: links, bold, italic, code).

tools.name: sendMediaFile
tools.description: Upload a local file to the relay media store and post it to a channel as the user, with an optional caption. Call getBuzzContext first to verify relay connection and channel state. Signed with their identity; images are re-encoded to strip metadata. A release action: only a person can post, by pressing Send in Buzz, or by approving it as CEO in the Executive team. An agent cannot call this at any trust level; write the text in the conversation for the person to send.

path.description: Absolute path of the file to send (max 10MB).

channelId.description: Channel id. Defaults to the active channel.

caption.description: Text to send with the file.

tools.name: discoverAppTools
tools.description: Discover Buzz's extended specialist tools (5 tools across channels, media, messages, people, search) and composite functions (4 workflows). Prefer calling exposed composite functions and core tools first; use discoverAppTools when an edge case needs a specialist tool, then call it via callExtendedReadTool (for read-only tools) or callExtendedTool (for mutating tools).

query.description: Optional keywords describing the capability you need (e.g. "channels", "media", "messages", "people", "search").

category.description: Optional category filter (channels, media, messages, people, search, or "all").

names.description: Optional exact tool names to fetch full JSON input schemas for.

includeFunctions.description: Include already-exposed composite functions and core tools in the listing (default false: searches extended tools first).

tools.name: callExtendedReadTool
tools.description: Call one of Buzz's read-only extended specialist tools discovered via discoverAppTools (categories: channels, media, messages, people, search). Strictly refuses mutating, destructive, external, or release tools.

tool.description: Exact name of a read-only extended tool from discoverAppTools.

arguments.description: Arguments object matching the tool’s inputSchema.

tools.name: callExtendedTool
tools.description: Call one of Buzz's mutating extended specialist tools discovered via discoverAppTools (categories: channels, media, messages, people, search). For destructive tools, set confirmDestructive: true after checking with the user. Strictly refuses read-only tools (use callExtendedReadTool), external tools, permanent-delete tools, and release tools (call sendMessage / sendDirectMessage / sendMediaFile directly).

tool.description: Exact name of a mutating extended tool from discoverAppTools.

arguments.description: Arguments object matching the tool’s inputSchema.

confirmDestructive.description: Required (true) when calling an extended tool marked risk: "destructive".
